   22 | export const RoleLoginPage: React.FC<RoleLoginPageProps> = ({
   23 |   role,
   24 |   onSuccess,
   25 |   onNavigateHome
   26 | }) => {
   27 |   const roleConfig: DemoRoleConfig = DEMO_ROLES[role];
   28 |   const { login: taxGuardLogin } = useApp();
   29 | 
   30 |   const [loginId, setLoginId] = useState('');
   31 |   const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
   32 |   const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
   33 |   const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
   34 |   const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
   35 |   const [lockoutRemaining, setLockoutRemaining] = useState(0);
   36 |   const normalizedLoginId = loginId.trim().toLowerCase();
   37 | 
   38 |   /*
   39 |    * Login environment presentation:
   40 |    *
   41 |    * - Blank login page remains neutral.
   42 |    * - artest2026 is explicitly DEMO.
   43 |    * - Client email addresses are LIVE.
   44 |    *
   45 |    * This affects presentation only.
   46 |    * Authentication authority remains AppContext/Firebase/server.
   47 |    */
   48 |   const isDemoLogin =
   49 |     normalizedLoginId === 'artest2026';
   50 | 
   51 |   const isLiveClientLogin =
   52 |     role === 'client' &&
   53 |     normalizedLoginId.length > 0 &&
   54 |     normalizedLoginId !== 'artest2026';
   55 | 
   56 | 
   57 |   // Check if already authenticated
   58 |   useEffect(() => {
   59 |     if (DemoAuthService.isAuthenticated(role)) {
   60 |       onSuccess();
   61 |     }
   62 |   }, [role, onSuccess]);
   63 | 
   64 |   // Periodic lockout timer countdown
   65 |   useEffect(() => {
   66 |     const checkLockout = () => {
   67 |       const normalizedLoginId = loginId.trim().toLowerCase();
   68 | 
   69 |       // Demo lockout applies only to the isolated demo credential.
   70 |       if (normalizedLoginId !== 'artest2026') {
   71 |         setLockoutRemaining(0);
   72 |         return;
   73 |       }
   74 | 
   75 |       const remaining = DemoAuthService.getRemainingLockoutSeconds(role);
   76 |       setLockoutRemaining(remaining);
   77 | 
   78 |       if (remaining > 0 && !errorMessage) {
   79 |         setErrorMessage(
   80 |           `Account temporarily locked due to repeated failed attempts. Retry in ${remaining}s.`
   81 |         );
   82 |       }
   83 |     };
   84 | 
   85 |     checkLockout();
   86 |     const interval = setInterval(checkLockout, 1000);
   87 |     return () => clearInterval(interval);
   88 |   }, [role, errorMessage, loginId]);
   89 | 
   90 |   const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
   91 |     e.preventDefault();
   92 |     setErrorMessage(null);
   93 | 
   94 |     const normalizedLoginId = loginId.trim().toLowerCase();
   95 | 
   96 |     if (!normalizedLoginId || !password) {
   97 |       setErrorMessage('Please enter both Login ID and password.');
   98 |       return;
   99 |     }
  100 | 
  101 |     setIsSubmitting(true);
  102 | 
  103 |     try {
  104 |       /*
  105 |        * DEMO AUTHENTICATION
  106 |        *
  107 |        * Only the explicit artest2026 credential is allowed
  108 |        * through DemoAuthService.
  109 |        */
  110 |       if (normalizedLoginId === 'artest2026') {
  111 |         const result = await DemoAuthService.authenticate(
  112 |           role,
  113 |           normalizedLoginId,
  114 |           password
  115 |         );
  116 | 
  117 |         if (result.success) {
  118 |           setPassword('');
  119 |           setLockoutRemaining(0);
  120 |           onSuccess();
  121 |           return;
  122 |         }
  123 | 
  124 |         setPassword('');
  125 |         setErrorMessage(
  126 |           result.error || 'Invalid Login ID or password.'
  127 |         );
  128 | 
  129 |         const remaining =
  130 |           DemoAuthService.getRemainingLockoutSeconds(role);
  131 | 
  132 |         setLockoutRemaining(remaining);
  133 |         return;
  134 |       }
  135 | 
  136 |       /*
  137 |        * LIVE CLIENT AUTHENTICATION
  138 |        *
  139 |        * Normal client email accounts are authenticated through
  140 |        * AppContext -> Firebase -> TaxGuard firebase-session.
  141 |        *
  142 |        * DemoAuthService and its lockout counter are not used.
  143 |        */
  144 |       if (role !== 'client') {
  145 |         setPassword('');
  146 |         setErrorMessage(
  147 |           'This login identifier is not valid for this workspace.'
  148 |         );
  149 |         return;
  150 |       }
  151 | 
  152 |       const result = await taxGuardLogin(
  153 |         normalizedLoginId,
  154 |         password
  155 |       );
  156 | 
  157 |       setPassword('');
  158 |       setLockoutRemaining(0);
  159 | 
  160 |       if (result.success) {
  161 |         onSuccess();
  162 |         return;
  163 |       }
  164 | 
  165 |       setErrorMessage(
  166 |         result.error ||
  167 |         'Unable to authenticate the LIVE client account.'
  168 |       );
  169 |     } catch (error: any) {
  170 |       setPassword('');
  171 |       setLockoutRemaining(0);
  172 |       setErrorMessage(
  173 |         error?.message ||
  174 |         'Unexpected authentication failure. Please contact developer support.'
  175 |       );
  176 |     } finally {
  177 |       setIsSubmitting(false);
  178 |     }
  179 |   };
  180 | 
  181 |   return (
  182 |     <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#06172C] text-slate-100 flex flex-col font-sans antialiased selection:bg-[#C99A32] selection:text-[#06172C] relative">
  183 |       {/* Background Lighting & Texture */}
  184 |       <div className="absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none bg-[radial-gradient(ellipse_at_top,_var(--tw-gradient-stops))] from-[#0A2544]/80 via-[#06172C] to-[#030B16]" />
  185 |       <div className="absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none opacity-[0.03] bg-[radial-gradient(#C99A32_1px,transparent_1px)] [background-size:24px_24px]" />
  186 |

  276 | 
  277 |   const isDemoUrl = (raw: string): boolean => {
  278 |     const clean = raw.replace(/^#\/?/, '').replace(/^\/+/, '').replace(/\/+$/, '').toLowerCase().trim();
  279 |     if (clean === 'client/login' || clean === 'client/register') return false;
  280 |     if (clean.startsWith('error/')) return true;
  281 |     if (clean === 'portals' || clean.startsWith('portals/')) return true;
  282 |     if (clean.includes('/login') || clean.includes('/dashboard')) return true;
  283 |     return ['client-portal', 'reviewer-portal', 'staff-portal', 'cpa-portal', 'admin-dashboard', 'admin-portal', 'reviewer-workspace', 'accountant-workspace', 'portals'].includes(clean);
  284 |   };
  285 | 
  286 |   const getPageFromUrl = (): PageRoute | null => {
  287 |     if (typeof window === 'undefined') return 'home';
  288 |     const hash = window.location.hash || '';
  289 |     const pathname = window.location.pathname || '';
  290 | 
  291 |     if (isDemoUrl(hash) || isDemoUrl(pathname)) return null;
  292 | 
  293 |     if (hash) {
  294 |       const match = resolveRoute(hash);
  295 |       if (match) return match;
  296 |     }
  297 | 
  298 |     if (pathname && pathname !== '/') {
  299 |       const match = resolveRoute(pathname);
  300 |       if (match) return match;
  301 |     }
  302 | 
  303 |     return 'home';
  304 |   };
